Safety and compliance come first

Every installation must be assessed for electrical load, supply type, protection, earthing and cable route. Use applicable Malaysian Energy Commission (ST) requirements and suitably registered/qualified electrical personnel. Product approval and certification must be verified for the exact model before purchase or installation.

Read the Energy Commission (ST) EVCS guidance ↗ · Read TNB home-charger guide ↗

This website provides enquiry information only. Charger ratings, availability, certifications, prices and installation suitability must be confirmed for each project. This page does not claim product certification or manufacturer authorisation.

Before you place an order

Request the exact model number, applicable ST approval/COA and SIRIM documents where required, test reports, warranty terms, spare-parts availability, software/OCPP details, installation manual, and written confirmation of dealer/OEM rights. Verify claims with the relevant authority before advertising a product as certified.
